title: GrowthBook button (v2)
description: Squared-off 8px buttons: a filled brand-violet one that darkens on hover, and a hairline outline one whose border turns to the text colour. Optional trailing arrow; can stretch full width on phones.
notes: on dark bands put the button inside a dark-class surface: the outline turns white-on-navy by itself
name: growthbook-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: filled brand colour · outline: hairline border, transparent fill

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 40px (header) · md: 58px, tight padding (section CTAs) · lg: 58px, wide padding (hero)

props.name: arrow
props.description: show a small arrow after the label

props.name: fullOnMobile
props.description: stretch to the container's width below 1024px (as the original does on phones)
